Dick Murphy, having spotted the Hon. Sec. gazing wistfully at Utility pyjamas in the Strand, felt it was time he wrote, and sends New Year Greetings to all the Boys and THE Club!

Three members of the M.P.A. turned up to combine with our police members for a match in conjunction which resulted in a win for the club by 145 points to 207, scoring 13 a side. At the conclusion of the race Dick Murphy, who had assisted throughout with transport for judges, presented the awards.
The Harry Parkers, Frank Thompsons, Harry Hares, Dick Murphys and many more grand sportsmen, who although not perhaps first-class athletes, also served so well.

Dick Murphy has been very ill, but as far as is known, he also is on the way to recovery, but has retired from business. Len Rollins, one of our very keen members in pre-war years and one who still takes a very live interest in Club activities, has also been ill.
